title: Anthropic adds enterprise reports to explain AI spending
teaser: Anthropic is giving enterprise customers a way to see what their AI spending produces. The new reports combine internal analytics with employee surveys to show what teams worked on, what they made, what it cost and where workflows failed. The launch comes as Anthropic’s investor-shared financial data points to rapid growth in Claude Code: net revenue retention was 900%, meaning the same customers spent nine times more in the third quarter of 2026 than in the third quarter of 2025.
